name: AMC Beam Frame
description: A region frame with a beam of light that travels around its border and speeds up while the region has hover or focus.
useFor: Any region that deserves attention: a key Classic Report, an approval Form, a Chart, a KPI row or a Static Content summary.
helpText: Region template with a travelling border beam. Title and icon come from the region; buttons in Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create sit in the header, and Previous, Close and Next in the footer. Template options add a second beam, success or danger colors, a slower beam, no body padding or a visually hidden header. Under reduced motion the beam stops as a static gradient border; in forced-colors mode the frame becomes a plain system border.

templateOptions.name: Dual beam
templateOptions.help: Two beams chase each other around the border.

templateOptions.name: Success color
templateOptions.help: Beam and icon use the success palette color.

templateOptions.name: Danger color
templateOptions.help: Beam and icon use the danger and warning palette colors, for escalations.

templateOptions.name: Slow beam
templateOptions.help: Halves the beam speed for calmer pages.

templateOptions.name: No body padding
templateOptions.help: Removes side padding so reports and grids run edge to edge.

templateOptions.name: Hide header
templateOptions.help: Keeps the title for screen readers but hides the header visually.
